sar.narrative: Customer C04285, holder of card C04285-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-18 14:43 and 2016-12-18 14:52, 3 transaction(s) totalling $1,200.20 were made on the card online from device profile 'Windows | Windows 10 | edge 17.0 | 1920x1079': $400.05 (3553899, 2016-12-18 14:43), $400.08 (3553904, 2016-12-18 14:44), $400.07 (3553923, 2016-12-18 14:52). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. When contacted, the cardholder stated they did not make the transactions and still holds the card. The activity is suspicious because: 3 online purchases within 9 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($400.05, $400.08, $400.07; total $1,200.20). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-3841, CC-4124, CC-4086. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placed linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.

stop_reason: The requested verification settled it: the cardholder denied the activity, raising the probability to 0.97. Further graph steps would not change the actions (policy 6).
